page_title: AUX 1-0 ANG | Auxerre v Angers 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' The expression of the referee Francois Letexier is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) is shown a yellow card.
90+3' 1 - 0 Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) gets on the end of a cross and scores with a fine header that goes inside the right post!
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francois Letexier no option but to blow his whistle.
89' Angers are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

86' Florent Hanin (Angers) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
84' Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
81' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Auxerre comes to nothing.
80' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
79' Auxerre couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Yahia Fofana (Angers) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
78' Substitution. Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) in, Gaetan Perrin out.
77' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Jean-Eudes Aholou will be replaced by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers).
77' The referee signals a substitution. Bamba Dieng (Angers) is brought on as a substitute for Ibrahima Niane.
75' The Angers players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
72' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Carlens Arcus is replaced by Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers).
72' Substitution. Esteban Lepaul (Angers) replaces Jim Allevinah.
71' Theo Bair (Auxerre) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
70' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
66' Christophe Pelissier has decided to substitute Kevin Danois and he is replaced by Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre).
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Theo Bair (Auxerre) is replacing Lassine Sinayoko.
65' Jordan Lefort (Angers) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
64' Himad Abdelli (Angers) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
62' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Farid El Melali (Angers), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
61' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
60' A cross into the box from Himad Abdelli (Angers) is cleared.
56' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) was unmarked on the edge of the box when he received the ball after a rebound, but his header was rather naive and the goalkeeper saved it easily.
55' The resulting set piece from Angers is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' Farid El Melali (Angers) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.

54' A big opportunity is wasted by Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Yahia Fofana pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
53' The Auxerre players are exchanging some short passes.
53' The free kick from long range, taken by Angers, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
48' None of the Auxerre players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
48' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Auxerre.
47' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
46' Auxerre enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Referee Francois Letexier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
44' The current number of corner kicks is 0:0.
41' Auxerre are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
40' Auxerre couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Yahia Fofana (Angers) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
39' It looks like Farid El Melali (Angers) saw red with that tackle. Francois Letexier won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
38' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Yahia Fofana was alert and made an astonishing save!
36' A pass by Florent Hanin (Angers) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
35' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
33' Yellow card. Carlens Arcus (Angers) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
32' Jim Allevinah (Angers) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) finds himself some space and fires in a superb first-time shot from long distance low towards the middle of the goal. Yahia Fofana makes a good save to deny him.
29' Ball possession – 43:57.
26' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
26' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) commits a rough foul. Francois Letexier stops the game and makes a call.
23' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
22' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
19' Auxerre hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

15' Jim Allevinah (Angers) was waiting for the ball on the edge of the box and produced a powerful volley directed low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save to deny him.

14' Donovan Leon (Auxerre) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Yahia Fofana has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
10' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Donovan Leon.
10' Some great controlled play and passing from Angers. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Himad Abdelli (Angers) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gideon Mensah (Auxerre), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
2' Himad Abdelli (Angers) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
